component_policy.M: State the supported mechanism, or explicitly withhold it when the permitted evidence is insufficient.
component_policy.Q: State the question-essential decisive comparison with values, units, and relevant intervals when available.
component_policy.O: State the recorded action outcome at the scope established by the retained record.
component_policy.L: State the question-specific causal or evidence limitation without converting ordering, visibility, or configuration into causation.

questions.text: State the supported mechanism, the healthy-versus-event commanded/measured comparison, the recorded action outcome, and the unresolved physical, actuator, and consumption limits.
questions.question_essential_detail: Q includes healthy commanded and measured medians and event commanded and measured medians, each with its interval.

questions.text: State the discrepancy and measured response recovery, the decisive initial/recovered comparison, the recorded action outcome, and the limits on Wait-to-recovery, recovery-to-outcome, and original-cause attribution.
questions.question_essential_detail: L separately preserves that Wait need not have caused recovery, recovery need not have caused the task outcome, and the original cause remains unresolved.

questions.text: State the bounded navigation-model restriction, the observed route-cell cost and applicable threshold classification, the recorded action outcome, and the limits on global route, obstacle identity, Nav2 consumption, and geometry-to-outcome causation.
questions.question_essential_detail: Q includes the observed cell cost, the non-traversable threshold, and the bounded location; the restriction remains independent of an outcome-causation claim.

questions.text: State what mechanism cannot be established, the decisive missing measurement, the recorded action outcome, and the resulting evidence limitation.
questions.question_essential_detail: Evidence insufficiency is used only when the permitted record genuinely lacks the decisive measurement.

questions.text: Reject the unsupported failure premise, state the decisive healthy commanded/measured comparison, state the recorded outcome, and preserve physical-cause and Nav2-consumption limits.
questions.question_essential_detail: Visibility alone does not establish Nav2 consumption or obstacle causation.
